classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding sides of nested similar rectangles with different orientations and calculate an exact fractional length.

content.prompt: Rectangles ACDF and EBCD are similar. Find the value of $x$.

spec.description: Schematic outer rectangle ACDF with vertical partition BE forming right-hand rectangle EBCD. All six vertex labels and right-angle squares are retained. The blue double-headed arrow identifies the horizontal width x.
spec.mathematics: AC = 18 cm, AF = BE = CD = 5 cm, and BC = ED = x cm. Similarity pairs the outer horizontal side with the inner vertical side and the outer vertical side with the inner horizontal side. Drawing proportions are schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the unknown x appear; the supplied answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Corresponding sides are $AC$ and $BE$, and $AF$ and $BC$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{5}&=\frac{5}{18}\\x&=\frac{5}{18}\times5\\x&=\frac{25}{18}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
